The 380-780nm denominator gap is upgraded from 'unpulled' to 'MEASUREMENT ABSENT IN THE AUDITED CLASSIC SERIES': a qualifying tier-1 denominator requires a new measurement or acceptance of a derived value.

leg_ii_blocker: Leg (ii) is un-evaluable until SS12 item 4 (absolute radiance-gate dataset) closes: no gated wavelengths or gate uncertainty exist yet. Structural dependency, independent of leg (i).

classic_1e-4.audit: P2 AUDIT RESULT (owner, 2026-08-06): Samaniego 1995 is explicitly a NUMERICAL INVESTIGATION - not a measured absolute CO2* W/HRR record; Stanford brief and DLR spectroscopy also fail the absolute-power-ratio requirement. RECLASSIFIED as model evidence. The only no-lab route is Slack-Grillo/Liu as a derived record with the full SS7.0 derived-record uncertainty budget.

Computable route: Slack & Grillo 1985 CO2* kinetics (via Nori & Seitzman AIAA 2008-953 Eq.3) + Liu, Tan, Wan, Zhang & Yao 2020, ACS Omega 5:15922 calibrated CH*/OH* fields (attribution corrected 2026-08-06)

open_upper_bound.source: Samaniego, CTR Annual Research Briefs 1994, Table 2 p.31 (open, read)

owner_ruling_2026_08_05: OWNER RULING 2026-08-05 - policy closed, record stays preview: computed bounds QUALIFY IN PRINCIPLE under revised SS7.0 language ('a pinned evidence record reports a one-sided 95%-confidence upper bound, obtained either directly or through a validated measurement model over traceable measured inputs; a derived record must include measurement, covariance, digitization, geometry, spectral-truncation, domain-transfer, and model-form uncertainties' - design-loop edit pending), but the present Slack-Grillo + Liu + Hamins construction FAILS it: kinetics model is not a same-case measurement; methane-field transfer to this fuel is an unbounded domain-transfer discrepancy; numerator channel completeness undemonstrated; chi_r x soot-T is not a measured visible denominator (~5x reconstruction spread); leg (ii) untestable until Q4 freezes. Lab work not required by definition; required for any fuel whose model discrepancy cannot be bounded from same-regime data.
verdict: INDETERMINATE at the 1% threshold: defensible open-literature bound fails by ~2 orders; plausible unverified estimates straddle 1%. Not a 95%-confidence record in either direction.
